comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Firm had $40.7 billion and $40.5 billion in cash and securities pledged with clearing organizations, and $26.8 billion and $20.5 billion in restricted securities related to customer activity, respectively.

BAC holds $4.0 billion in segregated cash and $18.3 billion in securities for securities regulations. JPM reports $40.7 billion in cash and securities pledged with clearing organizations and $26.8 billion in restricted securities for customer activity. Both companies treat these assets as restricted components of their cash and liquidity profiles.
